scope: opt-in metadata queue, full-hash reselect and manually authorized file transfer; not WAN or real hardware
checks: explicit opt-in persists only metadata and independently matching complete SHA-256 for two files
expanded stored queue has no horizontal page/component overflow at a 390px viewport; screenshot is not mobile hardware evidence
sender refresh preserves metadata but discards File bindings and old pairing identity; a new invitation does not send files
same-metadata different-content original is rejected by full SHA-256 without binding or sending any file
correct originals selected in reverse order are rebound only after full hashes match; fresh matching safety codes still gate manual sending
manual send requires explicit acceptance per file, final verified completion removes one entry at a time, and Blob saving gates the next offer
both downloaded files independently match local Node SHA-256 and byte lengths
synthetic localStorage quota failure is visible and never binds files or sends an offer
corrupt metadata remains unsendable and is deleted only after an explicit clear action

hashTiming.scope: small synthetic files on one CI host; wall time includes file chooser/UI/IPC; not CPU, RSS, mobile hardware or WAN performance
hashTiming.countedOperations: successful save and correct reselect only; deliberate wrong-file and quota passes excluded
